protocol: Frozen YOLO-derived controller transferred unchanged to all detectors. One measured serial run per policy/model, no test retuning. Fixed25ms service deadline chosen before runs. Validation-first-frame profiles only; labels never provided to policy. Shared workstation; no energy claims.
limitations: YOLO test split has previously been examined in the repository. First test evaluation of the two new families.
YOLO training budget/recipe differs from the provisional two-hour additional-family runs; results describe these checkpoints, not controlled architecture superiority.
Internal preprocessing differs between YOLO and Torchvision; same long side, not identical padded input tensors.
Resolution576 chosen before this evaluation from existing project deployment and new-family validation settings.
GT original native label geometry as repository evaluator; training validation used clipped GT.
218 mostly short M3FD groups; not continuous video or an independent untouched test after the fixed-resolution comparison.
Local adaptive baselines, not published system reproductions. One trial per case, no confidence intervals.
